newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal sets 10 bln esc variable rate repo.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal sets 10 bln esc variable rate repo.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal offered to inject 10 billion escudos of eight-day funds into the money market in a variable rate securities repurchase tender effective on Tuesday at the start of a new accounting period.
The central bank also offered to drain liquidity on Tuesday with four-week and nine-week money market certificates.
It left the absorption rate used for draining liquidity from the money market unchanged at 6.20 percent.
Its emergency lending rate for up to 100 billion escudos of one-day funds to resident banks was unchanged at 8.30 percent.
